scientific_role: separate follow-up dose-response; never merged into the core 4x4 result identity

cohort.selection: all 30 frozen evaluation states in manifest task/state order

dose.interpolation_variable: the final normalized denoised future-video latent recorded by the core runner
dose.present_frame: identical frozen observation latent at every alpha; explicitly overwritten after interpolation
dose.cache_installation: recompute the complete official t=0 predicted-video K/V cache from L_alpha before action denoising
dose.action_noise: reuse the exact frozen b0 action-noise tensor at every alpha
dose.claim_scope: pathwise sensitivity along one fixed latent segment; not semantic naturalness or a population intervention over future concepts

analysis.action_view: three action frames actually executed by LIBERO; discard the conditioned first frame
analysis.state_response: projection of A_alpha-A_0 onto A_1-A_0, divided by squared endpoint distance
analysis.primary_state_statistic: OLS slope of the three interior projected responses at alpha 0.25, 0.5, 0.75
analysis.primary_cohort_estimate: unweighted mean of the 30 state slopes
analysis.confidence_interval: percentile bootstrap resampling 30 states with replacement; 50000 repetitions; seed 260906
analysis.randomization_test: independently permute the three interior alpha labels within every state, recompute cohort mean slope; 100000 repetitions; seed 260907
secondary_descriptives: fraction of states with nondecreasing interior projected response
mean absolute deviation of interior projected response from alpha
all five alpha-wise cohort means and state-bootstrap intervals
analysis.endpoint_policy: alpha 0 and 1 are integrity anchors reused from core and are excluded from the primary slope/permutation statistic
analysis.zero_endpoint_contrast_policy: report the state as projection-undefined and fail the preregistered complete-cohort analysis; do not substitute another ordered pair
